purpose: Teach: スナップ/ソックス/メッシュ/１番/合コン/酔っ払っ/愛嬌/おしっこ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、文化祭でスナップ写真撮りまくってたな
lines.en: Riku, you were snapping photos non-stop at the culture festival.
lines.style: Playful accusation with a slight smirk. Light, teasing tempo. Eyebrow raised. The opening word lands with mock-stern familiarity.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ハイソックスばっか履いてたな、桜
lines.en: You were wearing nothing but high socks all day, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick comeback, equally smug. Unbothered delivery. Slight shrug in the voice. He's matching her energy exactly — no lag, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のジャージ、メッシュ素材で涼しそうだな
lines.en: That mesh jersey of yours actually looks pretty breathable, Riku.
lines.style: Observation wrapped as a compliment. Genuine curiosity underneath the deflection. Softer than the last line — not quite admitting she's noticed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、クラスで成績１番だったろ、桜
lines.en: You were top of the class, weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Slow, almost accusatory drawl. Raises the stakes slightly — calling out something he actually respects but won't say directly. Cool distance maintained.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、大学生の従兄から合コン話聞いたろ
lines.en: Heard your older cousin who's at uni was telling you about some group dating thing.
lines.style: Fishing. Casual surface, but listening intently underneath. Leans back slightly. The question mark in his tone is deliberate — he's testing whether she'll bite.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行先で誰か酔っ払ってたって?桜
lines.en: Someone got drunk on the school trip, right? That was you?
lines.style: Gentle push into confession. The final tag is softer, almost vulnerable — he's checked his smirk. Genuinely waiting for her answer.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、新入生に愛嬌振りまいてたな
lines.en: You were charming the new first-years pretty hard, Riku.
lines.style: Flat accusation with hidden sting. She's caught him in something that matters. The delivery is matter-of-fact but the subtext is sharp.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、小学生の時、おしっこ漏らしたって話してたろ、桜
lines.en: Didn't you tell someone you peed yourself in elementary school, Sakura.
lines.style: Rapid fire, no mercy. He's smiling but the words are close and final. A beat of silence should follow — he's just dropped the ultimate ammunition. Close to her ear, almost intimate in how brutal it is.
